The “Cruise Control” function is managed by engine control unit M010 by controlling the left steering wheel stalk control H005 (connector D).

The control is supplied from an ignition-operated line (INT from the steering lock control unit) - pin 2 - protected by fuse F49 of the underfacia junction unit B002.

The control H005 is connected to control unit M10:

- at pin 25 of connector A, with the ON/OFF signal

- at pin 28 of connector A, with the RESUME signal;

- at pin 35 of connector A, with the SET + signal;

- at pin 36 of connector A, with the SET - signal.

Engine control unit M010 controls the Cruise Control function by means of the brake pedal released signals (N.C. contact) from the second contact of brake pedal switch I030, the signal from clutch switch I031, the signal from accelerator pedal K055 and the speedometer signal from the ABS/ESP M051 control unit via the CAN network.

See E5030 PETROL ENGINES ELECTRONIC MANAGEMENT

Control unit M010 also receives signals used by the automatic transmission control unit M055 and ABS/ESP control unit M051 via the CAN network.

See E1050 CAN CONNECTION LINES

Engine control unit M010 connects via the CAN line to the Body Computer and instrument panel E050 to manage the Cruise Control on warning light.
